scope: Compact pole-matched star routing and actual revised reference-DXF topology/current/force checks. Prescribed-PM free space, imposed balanced current. Not manufacturing acceptance, firmware calibration, move power, driver or measured hardware qualification.

routing.applies_to: Explicit pole_matched=1 three-phase star. Already the default for new application projects.
routing.phase_order: A/B/C leads and neutral follow sorted opening X, not the physical A/C/B belt order
routing.physical_layer_note: CAD indices run bottom-to-top; generated indices run top-to-bottom. Existing reverse_layers=true matches the reference drawing's driver at Z=0. No hidden reflection or default-orientation change.
routing.reference_two_layer_match: Every trace, neutral POLYLINE stub and via matches at 1e-5 mm in XY/layer-pair coordinates; physical XY/Z checked with matching outer-layer orientation.
routing.fanout_shape: Uncapped projected braid slope and native via Y row pitch; unique full-stack series barrels with exactly two intended inner-layer landings

reference_limitations.diagnostic_scope: Assign net-0 barrels only to the uniquely determined phase at their actual landings, in a test copy. No conductor endpoint moved, trace added, polarity changed or source byte edited. B remains disconnected in the six-layer endpoint graph after this label-only diagnostic. Physical finite-width copper union/manufacturability is not inferred from LINE entities.
reference_limitations.reference_physical_spacing_note: Source planes are 1.6 mm apart, so the four-layer source spans 4.8 mm. It is not a same-depth thrust comparison with the generated 1.6 mm total-stack cases below.

generated_force_assumptions.orientation: Unreflected; physical driver on the last generated layer. Orientation regressions separately cover all eight reflection combinations.
generated_force_assumptions.drive: Zero-sum balanced ABC basis with one common phase reference from the actual signed map, no individual current-sign changes

generated_verification.layer_force_gate: Minimum 98% amplitude retention; every pair's signed force-curve cosine with the first pair greater than 0.99, and directed phase-axis error less than 1 degree. Absolute current-limited thrust is not used as an efficiency claim.
generated_verification.unchanged_mesh_gate: norm change <= max(1e-8 N/A, 2% of fine norm), per phase
generated_verification.DFM: New compact and legacy modes retain clearance warnings without changing requested geometry. No fabrication approval.

evidence.force_receipts: <case>.force.json files retain independent signed per-layer and per-pair curves for both meshes. No partial failed run substituted for a successful receipt.
evidence.setup_failures_preserved: workspace-tests.log has the old nine-period assertion; source-2/ records missing explicit CAD terminal selections. Complete successful runs use the distinct verified/picked paths above.
